column3: Close to the Greek; NKJV has the order “Jesus Christ” where the Greek reads “Christ Jesus.”
NKJV has “the fruits of righteousness,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the fruit of righteousness.”
NKJV has here the clause about those who preach Christ from selfish ambition, following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has it as verse 17 and the clause about love as verse 16.
NKJV has here the clause about those who preach out of love, following the Textus Receptus; in the critical text this is verse 16.
